system.description:
“I am a leaf on the wind; watch how I soar.” You are a master of effortless evasion, using your connection to the air to flow through the battlefield untouched and turn your enemies’ clumsy attacks into their own undoing.

LEVEL 3

Shape Air (1).

1+ Actions, Reach: 6. Describe your Small or Tiny air effect to the GM, or choose one from the list below. The longer or more powerful the effect, the more Actions it costs. Effects must be utilitarian and cannot replace attacks or tiered abilities.

  • Manipulate the air by changing its direction, smell, or temperature.
  • Muffle a sound in Reach to a whisper by altering air pressure.
  • Disperse a breeze or clear an area of smoke or gas.
  • Swirl air creating a pressurized pocket of breathable air.
  • Push an object 1 space with a gust.

Novice Wind Rider.

You take no damage from falling as long as you are conscious. You can slow your fall to 4 spaces a round. Your unarmed strikes can deal Bludgeoning or Slashing damage. You no longer learn any Martial Arts Abilities. You learn all Novice (Sho) Air Forms. When you roll initiative, you gain +1 Bursts of Speed.

LEVEL 7

Shape Air (2).

You can now manipulate up to a Medium volume of air.

Intermediate Wind Rider.

Your unarmed strikes become Reach 4. While falling, you can glide. While gliding you can move horizontally 2 spaces for every 1 space you fall, this counts as a move but ignores your maximum speed. You learn all Intermediate (Ga) Air Forms. Your forms grow stronger. When you roll initiative, you gain +1 Bursts of Speed (total 2).

LEVEL 11

Shape Air (3).

You can now manipulate up to a Large volume of air.

Advanced Wind Rider.

(1/round) While falling, gliding or flying, you can use 1 BoS maneuver for free. You learn all Advanced (De) Air Forms. Your forms grow stronger.

LEVEL 15

Shape Air (4).

You can now manipulate up to a Huge volume of air.

Expert Wind Rider.

While flying or gliding, your unarmed attacks have Reach 6. When gliding, you can move 3 spaces for every 1 space you fall now. You learn all Expert (Yoi) Air Forms. Your forms grow stronger. When you roll initiative, you gain +1 Bursts of Speed (total 3).

Air Forms

Air Forms are special techniques that replace Martial Arts Abilities. They follow the same rules for Spells and other effects and use your Hero DC when needed. There are 4 ranks of forms: Novice (Sho), Intermediate (Ga), Advanced (De) and Expert (Yoi) and cost 0, 1, 2, or 3 Bursts of Speed to activate respectively. Each form gains bonuses as Wind Rider increases. Forms can deal Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage (whichever feels most fitting).

Novice (Sho) Forms — 0 Bursts of Speed

Air Ball (Sho Form) — 1 Action
Reach: 6, Damage: 1d4+KEY. On hit: push a Large or smaller target or yourself 1 space. You do not take damage from this form’s forced movement ending early. High Levels: die step increases every Wind Rider. Expert Wind Rider: is considered a melee attack for Reverberating Strikes.

Leaf on the Wind (Sho Form) — 1 Action
Reach: 6, Reaction: When attacked or forced to make a save in an AoE. Move 1 space for free before the attack/save resolves. If you’re out of reach or no longer in the area, you are unaffected. High Levels: +1 space every Wind Rider. Expert Wind Rider: fly until the start of your next turn.

Wind Wall (Sho Form) — 1 Action
Wall: 4. Create a wall of wind that lasts 1 round. Ranged attacks have disadvantage passing through this wall. High Levels: Wall +2 every Wind Rider. Expert Wind Rider: Ranged attacks deal DEX less damage when passing through the wall.

Air Scooter (Sho Form) — 1 Action
Move: Up to your speed, ignoring Slowed Terrain. You can move on vertical surfaces as if it were normal ground. High Levels: +2 speed every Wind Rider. Expert Wind Rider: at the end of this move you can launch yourself into the air up to 12 spaces.

Intermediate (Ga) Forms — 1 Burst of Speed

Air Blast (Ga Form) — 2 Actions
Reach: 6, Damage: 4d4+16, Vicious. On hit: push a Large or smaller target or yourself up to 4 spaces. You do not take damage from this form’s forced movement ending early. High Levels: +8 damage and +2 spaces pushed every Wind Rider. Expert Wind Rider: you can push Huge or smaller targets.

Air Pull (Ga Form) — 2 Actions
Reach: 6, Damage: 4d4+16, Vicious. On Hit: pull a Large or smaller target 2 spaces closer to you. High Levels: +8 damage and +1 space pulled. Expert Wind Rider: you can pull Huge or smaller creatures.

Twisting Wind (Ga Form) — 2 Actions
Burst: 1, Concentration: Up to 1 minute. Wind fills the area. Enemies inside are Slowed while allies gain +2 speed. High Levels: Speed +2 and Burst +1 every Wind Rider. Expert Wind Rider: Ranged attacks into the area are considered 1 lower. Crits ignore this effect.

Air Dash (Ga Form) — 2 Actions
Line: 6, Move: to the end of the Line ending in an empty space, Damage: 4d4+8 to enemies on a failed DEX save and are pushed 1 space out of the area. On a save, half damage and they aren’t pushed. High Levels: +8 damage and Line +2 every Wind Rider. Expert Wind Rider: fly until the start of your next turn.

Advanced (De) Forms — 2 Bursts of Speed

Breath of Wind (De Form) — 2 Actions
Arc: 6, Damage: 4d4+16. Large and smaller targets are knocked Prone on a failed STR save. On save, targets aren’t knocked Prone. Expert Wind Rider: +6 damage and Arc +2 and hitting one target deals +LVL damage and they automatically fail their save.

Air Bomb (De Form) — 1 Action
Burst: 2, Reaction: When you are flying, gliding or falling. Immediately land on the ground. Enemies in the area must make a STR save. On a fail, they take damage equal to the potential fall damage and are pushed out of the area. On a save they take half damage only. Expert Wind Rider: Burst +1 and you immediately launch back in the air 12 spaces.

Cyclone (De Form) — 2 Actions
Reach: 6, Blast: 6, Concentration: Up to 1 minute. The area swirls with buffeting winds. Enemies take KEY damage for each space they enter or if they start or end their turn in the area. While inside, enemies can’t see outside the area. You can reposition the AoE in range with 1 Action. Ignores armor. Expert Wind Rider: +2d4 damage and Large and smaller enemies cannot fly in the area.

Reed in the Wind (De Form) — 1 Action
You can use Leaf On the Wind for free until the start of your next turn. Expert Wind Rider: each time you use Leaf On the Wind and are unaffected by ability, you can retaliate with an Air Ball if the attacker is in reach.

Expert (Yoi) Forms — 3 Bursts of Speed

Air Vacuum (Yoi Form) — 2 Actions
Reach: 6, Blast: 4. Targets adjacent to the area must succeed a STR save or be pulled into the area. The area implodes, dealing 4d4+24 damage. Creatures inside the area take maximum damage. Ignores armor. Creatures adjacent to the area take damage as normal. Doesn’t ignore armor.

Rider’s Wind (Yoi Form) — 2 Actions
Burst: 4, Concentration: Up to 1 minute, Damage: 4d4+8. Huge and smaller targets must make a STR save or be pushed 6 spaces away and knocked Prone. On a save, they are pushed 2 spaces away and not knocked Prone. Spend 2 Actions to repeat this effect while concentrating.

Spiritual Projection (Yoi Form)
You use your Ethereal Projection by meditating for at least 10 minutes. However, there is no limit to how far your projection can be from you. You can choose to physically interact with the environment, but once you do this, the projection transfers any damage it takes to you. This lasts as long as you meditate. This does not count against your 1/day usage of Ethereal Projection.

Freedom of the Sky (Yoi Form) — 1 Action
For the next 24 hours, you gain a fly speed equal to three times your walking speed. Ranged attacks against you have disadvantage. For the duration, you gain 1 BoS at the start of your turns while in initiative. Once you use this form, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before doing so again.
